questions.question: 3. Prim’s algorithm is similar to Dijkstra Algorithm

explanations.a: Correct. Both algorithms select the shortest edge that leads to a new node. The difference lies in the logic of classifying an edge as shortest in both cases.
explanations.b: Incorrect. Prim’s algorithm is indeed similar to Dijkstra's Algorithm in its approach.
